name: pokemon-card-index
description: Every English and Japanese Pokémon TCG card in one offline, instantly searchable page, with prices.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true})" && node scripts/build-catalog.js build/sources build/catalog.json && node scripts/fetch-tcgdex-products.js build/sources && node scripts/merge-pricecharting.js data/pricecharting build/pc_data.json && node scripts/assemble.js
scripts.refresh: npm run sources && npm run graded && npm run build
